chunks: And beware of haste in matters before their proper time, or slowness in them when they are due, or stubbornness in them when their propriety becomes unclear, or weakness regarding them when they become clear. Place every matter in its proper place, and perform every action at its appropriate time.

key_terms.أَوَانِهَا: Their proper time or appointed season.
key_terms.اسْتَوْضَحَتْ: It became clear, evident, or manifest.
key_terms.التَّسَقُّطَ: Slowness, negligence, or failing to act when the opportunity or duty arises.
key_terms.اللَّجَاجَةَ: Stubbornness or insistence on a course of action even when its appropriateness has changed or become unclear.
key_terms.الْعَجَلَةَ: Haste or rushing into matters before their proper time.
key_terms.الْوَهْنَ: Weakness, lethargy, or lack of vigor in carrying out a duty when it has become clear and necessary.

ai.seo_question: What are the four behavioral pitfalls in leadership and decision-making according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This excerpt from Imam Ali's instructions to Malik al-Ashtar emphasizes the virtue of timing and discernment in governance and personal conduct. It warns against four specific errors: acting too early, delaying when action is due, persisting when the situation changes, and giving up when clarity is achieved. The core teaching is to assign every matter its proper context and execute every deed at the right moment.
